summary.text: Simone Coleman is the Working Class Party candidate for Michigan's 13th District and has run for office in Detroit-area races before. Little other biographical information is available in public sources.

paragraphs.text: Ran as the Working Class Party candidate for Michigan House District 14 in 2020.
Appeared on the general-election ballot for Michigan's 13th District in 2022 and 2024, and advanced from the Working Class Party convention for the 2026 race on June 6, 2026.
